newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury 3-,6-mo bills seen at 5.005, 5.105 pct.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury 3-,6-mo bills seen at 5.005, 5.105 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's sale of $26 billion in three- and six-month bills is expected to produce rates of 5.005 percent and 5.105 percent, respectively, dealers said Tuesday.
"The market is very quiet today... but I think the bills will meet good demand and be placed all right," said a trader at a primary dealership in New York.
In when-issued trading before the 1300 EDT/1700 GMT bidding deadline, the three-month bills were at 5.005 percent while the six-month securities were at 5.10 percent.
